messages:
Rina K: Heads-up: SI onboarding playbook dry-run on Friday. We need to validate marketplace listing flows + HW voucher redemption during the lab. Can marketplace team confirm listing visibility for partner orgs?
Ben L: Confirmed. Listings in `redwood-marketplace:private` are visible to approved partner org ids. Ran a visibility check with org-id `org-8342` and it shows the entry. Will watch for replication lag.
Cass M: For the HW voucher flow: remind partners to claim voucher in portal before the lab. The voucher code redemption endpoint is `POST /marketplace/v1/vouchers/redeem` — sample payload attached in the doc.
Talia H: Trainers will simulate a hardware failure scenario. Do we have an alternate plan if a partner cannot redeem vouchers during the session? Maybe provide pre-burned VMs as fallback.
PartnerOnboardBot: audit-bot: voucher creation event recorded for code `SI-BOOT-2026-01` (2026-04-13T19:02:00Z).
Rina K: Good call on fallback. Ben, can marketplace produce 3 pre-burned VM images that trainers can SSH into as backup? Need those by Thursday EOD.
Ben L: Yep, I'll queue image bake: `si-onboard-2026-fallback-1..3`. ETA Thu 18:00 PT. Will upload to partner-bucket and post links.
Cass M: Also dropping a short smoke test to validate voucher redemption + marketplace API auth: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"code":"SI-BOOT-2026-01"}' https://marketplace.redwood.ai/v1/vouchers/redeem`
Talia H: Final ask: can we include a 5min segment on incident reporting during the lab? Partners should know the on-call and how to open a support ticket with priority flags.
Rina K: Yep, adding to the run order. I'll also compile proctor contacts and the incident triage one-pager. Locking agenda by Thu 12:00 PT. :calendar:
